title: Cosmic Rays and Time Dilation
hook: What if particles created in the sky defy time itself?
script: What if particles created in the sky defy time itself? When cosmic rays smash into our atmosphere, they create muons. These fleeting particles exist for just 2.2 microseconds. Surprisingly, they reach the ground at near light speed. This is time dilation, stretching their brief lives. So how is it that billions of muons arrive here? Each minute, about one of these muons passes through every square centimetre of Earth. It’s a quiet reminder that Einstein's theories are at work above us.
